title: Memory package init, VectorStore and EmbeddingProvider interfaces
description:
Create chatbot/memory/__init__.py, chatbot/memory/vector_store.py, and chatbot/memory/embeddings.py.

chatbot/memory/__init__.py: Re-export the VectorStore and EmbeddingProvider abstract classes and the data types.

chatbot/memory/vector_store.py: Define an abstract VectorStore interface using abc.ABC with the following async methods:
- add(ids: list[str], embeddings: list[list[float]], metadata: list[dict] | None) → None — insert vectors with optional metadata
- search(embedding: list[float], top_k: int, filter: dict | None) → list[SearchResult] — cosine similarity search returning scored results
- delete(ids: list[str]) → int — delete vectors by id, return count deleted
- count() → int — total vector count

Define a SearchResult dataclass with fields: id (str), score (float), metadata (dict | None).

chatbot/memory/embeddings.py: Define an abstract EmbeddingProvider interface using abc.ABC with:
- async embed(texts: list[str]) → list[list[float]] — return one embedding vector per input text
- property dimension → int — the output embedding dimension

Both interfaces must use only stdlib abc. No third-party deps for these files. Annotate with @abstractmethod.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- This task document (task c.3)
- Any existing files in allowed_write_paths

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/memory/__init__.py exists and re-exports VectorStore and EmbeddingProvider
